text: 其中提到，市人民政府应当将脑机接口产业发展纳入本市国民经济和社会发展规划和科技创新专项规划，建立健全促进脑机接口产业发展的议事协调机制，统筹协调脑机接口技术创新、产业发展、行业应用、安全治理等方面的重要事项。市人民政府应当保障脑机接口基础研究领域的持续投入，支持各类创新主体开展脑机接口前沿交叉基础研究。市科技创新部门应当聚焦脑机接口产业关键核心环节，以工业制造、医疗健康、生活消费等方面需求为导向，支持企业联合高等院校、科研机构、医疗机构等组建创新联合体，开展脑机接口核心技术攻关，加快脑机接口产品应用落地。
text_en: It mentions that the municipal government should incorporate the brain-computer interface industry into the city's national economic and social development plan and special plans for sci-tech innovation, establish and improve coordination mechanisms to promote the industry's development, and coordinate matters related to technological innovation, industry growth, applications, and safety governance. The municipal government should ensure sustained investment in basic research for brain-computer interfaces and support various innovation entities in frontier interdisciplinary basic research. The municipal sci-tech innovation department should focus on key core segments of the BCI industry, oriented toward industrial manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer needs, support enterprises in forming innovation consortia with universities, research institutes, and medical institutions to tackle core BCI technologies and accelerate product deployment.
